Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Wood Bookcase, 34"W, Natural Rattan
Colors: Natural Rattan
Materials: rattan
This handsome bookcase is a versatile and charming accent piece for your home. Place in your living room and showcase your well-worn books and cherished family photos on the shelves, and store spare throws in the cabinet. Rattan adds a global touch. 34"L x 17"W x 76"H Poplar and rubberwood; birch veneer, rattan; metal Transitional style; rattan adds a global touch Three adjustable shelves; two doors provide concealed storage space Assembly in 30 minutes or less with two people Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
